content: Firestore JS SDK offline persistence (firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/manage-data/enable-offline): persistentLocalCache with persistentSingleTabManager is the current modular API; memoryLocalCache is the default when no cache configured. Cache caches a copy of actively-used data; reads/writes/listens/queries all work offline; auto-sync on reconnect. Default cache size threshold 100 MB with periodic cleanup of older unused documents (LRU); configurable via cacheSizeBytes (min 1MB) or CACHE_SIZE_UNLIMITED. While offline, listeners fire on local cache changes; snapshot.metadata.fromCache distinguishes cache (possibly stale) vs server (current). New offline queries initially run against cached docs only; empty result if nothing cached. disableNetwork() forces cache-only, writes queue until re-enabled. Optional local query index auto-configuration (indexConfiguration) speeds offline queries for large caches.
